answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops fakes. A new identity posts a 50-credit bond and builds a fingerprint across 20 epochs: tasks, rhythm, ties, a trail across a knoll, stamped with an umber mark. Watchful as a raven, a peer audit checks live behavior against the record; a mismatch freezes the bond. One forged fingerprint costs 40 credits; 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 against a 12,000 pool. Honest agents pay once, pass once, unlock escrow plus earnings.
